derivation: from G5228 (ὑπέρ) and the neuter plural of G1565 (ἐκεῖνος);
def: above those parts, i.e. still farther

occurrences.text: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man’s line of things made ready to our hand.
